suggestedCompanions.reason: Every cloudflaredReady, tunnelConnectorUp, tunnelConnectorDown, ingressRuleReloaded and accessGateRefused event writes through the applied logger; a logging companion supplies the factory.

A cloudflared exit, a JWT-check failure, an ingress-rule schema violation, a hostname-DNS-route API refusal constructs an internal error record; an error-handling companion supplies the record factory and the boundary.

elicits.prompt: The Cloudflare Tunnel name (also the manifest filename under cloudflare/tunnels/<name>.yaml). Names the connector in cloudflared tunnel list and in the routing DNS entries.
security-secrets-management reference to the Cloudflare zone the tunnel serves under. Read at apply time to create the DNS route; never inlined into the manifest.
Template for the public hostname (e.g. <service>.<zone>). The template is expanded per ingress rule at apply time.
Ingress rules array: each entry names a public hostname and the internal service URL to route to. The last entry is a mandatory catch-all http_status 404 (added by the blueprint if omitted).

Access AUD tag. When edge-cloudflare-access is applied (zeroTrustGate on appliedCapabilities) this value is MANDATORY: every ingress rule attaches originRequest.access.aud with it and cloudflared refuses any request without a valid Access JWT for that AUD. Apply refuses with code apply.tunnel-aud-missing if zeroTrustGate is applied and this value is blank. When edge-cloudflare-access is NOT applied the block is omitted and the tunnel serves in the deliberate public-hostname mode per ADR-4003.

Connector runtime per ADR-4002. compose-service is the shipped default when containerHost is applied (via platform-docker-compose-host on top of deploy-hetzner-server); systemd-unit is the alternative for a bare cloudHost per the cloudflared as-a-service local-configuration-file docs.
